title: EnvironmentLock
description: Exact resolved state for all tools in one development environment.

extensions.description:
Lossless future/backend fields. Unknown state must never disappear
merely because an older client rewrote a lock.

plan_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized environment plan that produced this lock.

tools.description: Logical tool name to one or more exact version/platform variants.

LockedArtifact.description: Archive/blob identity downloaded into the content-addressed store.

mirrors.description: Alternate immutable download locations. Order is not semantic.

sha256.description: Exact lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256, without a `sha256:` prefix.

signatures.description:
Signature, transparency-log, or attestation identities. Verification
policy remains a caller concern; the lock records what was verified.

LockedInstall.description: Verified install layout within an extracted artifact/store entry.

bin_dirs.description:
Relative PATH directories below `root`. Order is not semantic here;
activation precedence is defined by the environment plan/runtime.

executables.description: Executables and aliases exposed by this variant.

layout_digest_sha256.description:
Digest of normalized layout metadata when a backend has additional
deterministic install-layout decisions.

root.description:
Relative root selected from the extracted artifact. `.` means the
artifact root.

LockedPlatform.description: Exact target identity for one locked variant.

target.description: Canonical target triple or backend target identifier.

identity.description: Key, certificate, transparency-log, or issuer/subject identity.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of detached signature or attestation bytes.

LockedSource.description: Exact source identity used before artifact verification.

immutable.description: True when backend semantics guarantee that `revision` cannot move.

locator.description:
Registry coordinates, repository URL, HTTP URL, OCI reference, or a
project-relative path.

portable.description:
A relative path source may be marked portable only when its complete
tree identity is locked and intended to travel with the project.

revision.description: Exact package revision, VCS object, OCI digest, or backend identity.

tree_sha256.description: SHA-256 of a local directory tree for `path` sources.

LockedSourceKind.description: Source category for an exact tool artifact.

LockedTool.description: One exact backend/version/platform selection for a logical tool.

backend_options_digest_sha256.description: Digest of normalized backend options, excluding credentials/secrets.

backend_version.description:
Exact backend/plugin implementation version when backend behavior can
affect resolution or installation.

requirement.description: Original human-authored requirement retained for diagnostics.

resolved.description: Exact, non-moving version selected by the backend.
